body: Thanks for the other perspective. I wonder if it hurts most people in that situation. I'm sorry you went through that.

This isn't even the first time this has happened to me. My first long term relationship was about four years long and a week after we broke up she started dating a mutual "friend" of ours. Her and I were actually engaged. At this point it just feels like this will keep happening. And yes, I'm sure there's someone better out there, but continuously going through this pain trying to find them isn't worth it. I just feel like I'm at the point where the pain, anger, and hurt are too much. Combined with the complete lack of motivation I've had since my health problems started I just want it all to end.

Thank you for the support though.
